description: Claims read from manuscripts whose claim ledger is missing or holds only the shared 2026-10-23 process table. Each line number points at the sentence the claim restates.

claims.statement: The source census covers 8,037 files of the tracked PFP demos subtree and twenty findings notes, totaling 34,722,866 bytes; it fixes the intended copy inventory, not completed custody or execution.

Source custody holds only if the copied inventory is a bijection with the declared tracked inventory, bound by Git blob and raw SHA-256 per file; additional, missing, redirected or corrupted entries fail.

An import-path adaptation preserves the demonstration only when the permitted change is recorded and original and adapted bytes stay available; changes to carrier, case data, protected constraints, answer format or checker semantics need separate disclosure.

For the rational graph objective \(\Phi_1(\omega)=\min_u\sum_e|\omega_e-(u_b-u_a)|\), primal–dual equality certifies the optimum only after feasibility, divergence balance and the dual box bounds are checked; a runner's scalar is not a certificate.

Corrected historical findings: PASS_TO_MASTER labels are reference self-scores, several formal panels used answer-bearing case identifiers, the paired-bout ten-of-ten counted an always-true field, passing blind-cluster runs saw the answer, and the 28-probe study has no retained study.
Twenty synthetic custody controls and seventeen package-custody controls exercise byte changes, missing, additional and redirected copies, malformed manifests, traversal, collisions and drift.
claims.limit_text: Fixture behavior only; not custody of the complete snapshot.

claims.statement: The findings inventory covers 60 challenge IDs, 25 Genesis IDs and 13 aggregate families; replay checks 20 note digests, 769 section and line bindings and 343 referenced source files.
claims.limit_text: Coverage and source identity, not execution totals.

claims.statement: The C017 archived-algorithm replay runs 60 cases: 57 accepted by both retained checkers, 3 reference abstentions; all 12 declared mutations are rejected by both.
claims.limit_text: Checker agreement does not prove algorithmic independence.

claims.statement: A retained consistency checker accepts a schema-valid contradiction verdict for a graph whose native residual is zero, so the schema supplies no obstruction witness.

A fresh native replay of the MUB catalog reproduces its seven exact triples and 21 transition matrices; controls fix 20 sign patterns per identity and separate a Fourier matrix (0 failures) from the Tao matrix (20).
claims.limit_text: Finite catalog calculation; no claim about the dimension-six MUB problem.

claims.statement: Replaying the original Genesis artifact verifier on empty, wrong-task and unproved responses reproduces 75 erroneous verified:true outputs; of 11 historical CHECKED labels, 6 were timeouts, 2 failures and 3 absent snippets.

G07: the two depth-15 branch-fan trees have 963 and 1,847 nodes, reconciling the original 236 and 422 tie counts; source and native owners agree on 3,617 width cases; the largest observed width is 11.
claims.limit_text: The global width bound remains an open conjecture.

claims.statement: G01: the reading-F targets F-1, F-5 and F-K are proved under the unchanged sealed definitions; complete two-item populations give F ten responses in five classes and L six in three.
claims.limit_text: Held-out signatures are reconstructions; the frozen judge packet was unavailable.

claims.statement: G02: \(\operatorname{cutCensus}(n,a,b)=2^{n-2}\) for distinct in-range designated pairs, checked in Lean under the axiom whitelist; Python and native checkers agree on all 1,014 pair cases through carrier twelve.
G03: for the preregistered collapse-preserving adapter both fresh-mark predicates are false at \((3,1,2)\), and unary forms allow cost-one repairs, so the two-item fresh mark is not minimal.
claims.limit_text: Finite refutation for that adapter; the general G4 conjecture stays open.

claims.statement: G12: five isomorphism constructions compile as Prop wrappers at the original regime; two censuses agree on 12 parked modules, 141 constants and 5 constructors, with only propext and Quot.sound.

Native rank replay of demos 5–9: every consecutive boundary product vanishes; Demo 5's filled planar and Kagome complexes have \(b_1=0\), not 2 and 4, and Demo 9's claimed \(S^2\times S^2\) carrier has Betti vector \((1,0,1,2,1)\).
claims.limit_text: Rational ranks certify neither torsion nor manifold identity.

claims.statement: Integer Smith replay of the eight carriers: the torsion carrier has \(H_2=\mathbb Z/2\) with mod-two dimensions \((1,0,1,1)\); integral and mod-two results agree under the universal-coefficient check in every degree.

Formal-lemma replay: of 64 retained cases, 36 proofs and 22 refutations are accepted, 4 malformed statements refused, 2 abstain; all 48 mutations are rejected by both checkers, which share one compiler wrapper.

Native replay of retained higher-degree witnesses: the two \(\Phi_2\) dossiers have objectives 1 and 2 with zero gap; four degree-three/four witnesses give 1, 0, 1, 2; all near-misses are refused; K4, the four-spoke wheel and K5 have defects 21, 16, 27 and repaired defect 0.
Recovered role texts expose the original false AST terminal: a two-step run announces exact repair at defect pair (4,1) with four active defects.

Closed replays: local complementation [0,2,3] maps edges 01,02,13,23 to 03,12,23; a triangle is 3-colourable with [0,1,2] and its 2-colour encoding has a DRAT refutation; in the poset 0→1→2 the product of 1 and 2 is 1; the two category checkers disagree on 31 of 48 mutations.
claims.limit_text: A passing example does not certify a checker family's soundness.

claims.statement: No universal formulation guarantee, unrestricted solver, general model-accuracy result, dimension-six MUB solution or proof of every historical narrative follows from these finite checks.

Re-entry composition: under declared edge obligations a checked solution at \(P_n\) decodes to \(P_0\) by \(b_0\circ\cdots\circ b_{n-1}\); forward coverage maps compose in reverse; \(b_i\circ f_i=\mathrm{id}\) composes; with each operation costing \(\ge\delta>0\) against one budget \(B\), at most \(\lfloor B/\delta\rfloor\) operations run.
claims.limit_text: Conditional laws; they do not construct adapters or prove checker soundness.

claims.statement: Soundness does not imply coverage: with \(\operatorname{Sol}(P)=\{0\}\) and an empty target solution set, the empty backward map is sound but no forward coverage map exists.

Antibody transfer counterexample: \(r\) rejecting 1 is sound for \(\operatorname{Sol}(P)=\{0\}\) but destroys the only answer when \(\operatorname{Sol}(P')=\{1\}\); transfer needs a checked target validity condition.
The companion replay checks a two-operation unit-cost history under budget two and rejects a stale parent, a changed task and a child that resets consumed fuel.
claims.limit_text: Reference contract example, not every engine adapter.

claims.statement: Explicit incumbent re-entry is implemented; current model performance is unmeasured and three paired ignition repetitions are exploratory.

Gluing: a locally permitted family glues to a unique assignment on \(\bigcup_i S_i\) iff every pair agrees on its intersection; if the scopes cover \(V\), compatible families biject with global solutions.
Local success, global failure: the constraints \(x=y\), \(y=z\), \(z\ne x\) are each satisfiable but have no common solution; replacing the last by equality gives exactly \((0,0,0)\) and \((1,1,1)\).
claims.section: 3. Three local successes and one global obstruction

claims.statement: The reference replay enumerates all eight assignments, refuses the disagreeing family and accepts the compatible one; no model calls are made.
A complete six-step C, R, E, I, M, T execution is an integration observation, not a gluing theorem for effectful agents.

Exact quotient: a report \(q\) admits an exact quotient of the action table iff states in one fibre share terminal labels and, per action, enablement, enabled cost and successor fibre; legal words, reports, costs and best resolution cost are then preserved.
Coarsest stable refinement: splitting blocks by (disabled, or exact cost and successor block) terminates after at most \(|X|-1\) proper splits at the coarsest stable refinement of \(q_0\).
Counterexample: identifying two zero-report states whose finish costs 1 and 3 preserves the current output but not operating cost.
With positive costs a minimum-cost resolving word, when one exists, is a simple path of at most \(|X|-1\) transitions; in the example the cheapest route costs 2 against a direct route of 5.
Channel-independent soundness: if the decoder binds replies to task \(P\) and \(C(P,w)=\mathsf{accept}\Rightarrow R(P,w)\), the set of accepted invalid candidates is empty for every proposal channel.
claims.limit_text: No acceptance-rate or completeness bound follows.

claims.statement: On a directed \(k\)-cycle with claims \(c\), \(\operatorname{im}d_0=\ker d_1=\{\sum c'_i=0\}\) and \(\Phi_1(c)=\Gamma_2(c)=|s|=\max_{\partial_1z=0,\|z\|_\infty\le1}\langle z,c\rangle\), \(s=\sum_i c_i\).

The non-faithful prompt trees form a two-sided operad ideal \(\mathcal I\); in \(\mathcal O/\mathcal I\) the null tree absorbs on both sides, and a composite is nonzero iff every leaf span is byte-identical to its declared slice.
Masking logits to the admissible BPE token frontier keeps every prefix viable and every completed word in the target language.

With a sound and complete Stage-1 guard and conditionally independent retries, the theorem gives the Stage-1 admission probability, conditional Stage-2 precision and expected Stage-2 call savings of guarded retry with null-tree abstention.
Omitting the global cycle-sum equation leaves an infinite false-green kernel \(\mathcal K_{\text{false}}(x)\cong\mathbb Z\setminus\{0\}\), parameterised by the cycle-sum error.
For a spanning tree with \(b_1\ge2\) chords the chord-coordinate incidence of the fundamental cycle basis is \(I_{b_1}\), and the partial-guard false-green kernel has rank \(|V|-1+b_1\).

Tree-then-chord staging lowers the maximum per-turn slot arity from \(|V|-1+2b_1\) to \(\max(|V|-1,b_1)\), e.g. \((13,17,16,21,21)\to(5,7,6,9,7)\) on \(K_{3,3},Q_3,K_5\), Petersen, \(W_7\), and closes the two-stage false-green kernel.
Discrete Fredholm alternative: \(d\in\operatorname{im}d_0\) iff every chord holonomy \(r_m^*\) vanishes iff \(d=d_0p_T^*\); otherwise a nonzero holonomy witnesses the obstruction.
The syndrome \(\mathbf r^*=\hat{\mathbf c}^*-\mathbf c|_{E\setminus T}=S\mathbf c\) decodes verdict, single-edge repair and audit.

A single tree-edge integration error shifts the whole descendant subtree's potential while edge-local retry sees one local syndrome; path-integrated \(B_T^{-1}\) diagnostics identify the subtree in one step.
For C011–C020 the set of schema-valid SOLVED replies violating the witness relation is nonempty (infinite for integer or rational fields); independent exact certificate checking closes it.
Across the 12 mechanism and cohomology trials, guarded staging with null-tree abstention gave 40/40 conditional Stage-2 precision with 0 admitted false SOLVED verdicts in 242 guarded evaluations.
claims.limit_text: Precision on admitted cases, not solve rate.

claims.statement: qwen-2.5-7b-instruct passed the complete guard on 2/40 hidden C004 cases, 8/60 C006 boards and 0/10 C011–C020 certificates (10/10 abstained).
claims.limit_text: No general symbolic competence is claimed.

claims.statement: A repair request fixes an objective, source-hash manifest, allowed write set, text patch and check commands; the candidate identity hashes the patch and a separate digest binds the request.

The repair slice runs C (capture), R (observe), E (evaluate), I (incorporate), M (disposition), T (terminal), carrying run key, request digest and candidate identity; source application, production admission and detector activation are not performed.
Worked example: patching adjust(n) from n−1 to n+1 on the nonnegative branch moves check exits from [1,0] to [0,0]; the original source stays byte-identical.
The DDC test target exercises repair, ineffective and regressive candidates, source drift, forbidden patch scope, missing infrastructure, binding failures, Git addressing and same-size Python edits.
The workflow is a supplied-candidate executor, not an autonomous repair agent; it reports no change in model accuracy, cost or safety.
